title: Tiger Gorilla
tagline: He's a gorilla in tiger stripes with a rocket-powered bottom!
blurb: He's a gorilla in tiger stripes with a rocket-powered bottom! Swing through twelve wrap-round jungle levels, catching parrots to feed the hungry babies in the nest. Photographers prowl the floor, crocodiles lurk in the pools and camera drones hover over the Waterfall Gorge. Feed every baby and the family is safe!

quote.text: Grabbing and catching are both automatic, so it's all about rhythm and timing

credits.name: Zippy Dee, Marjorie Plunkett and Grumpy Ken for INK & PAPER

shots.caption: A sleepy croc, and a gorilla who isn't worried in the slightest. Wait till level 3.
